points.description: Names the mean (average) of the annual maximum precipitation series as a parameter influencing PMP estimation.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says 'average/mean rainfall' without the annual maximum idea.

points.description: Names the standard deviation of that annual maximum precipitation series as a parameter influencing PMP estimation.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating both the mean of annual maximum precipitation and its standard deviation, in any wording. Give 1 mark if only one of the two is given, or if both are only vaguely stated (e.g. 'average rainfall and variation'). Give 0 for unrelated parameters such as area or evaporation alone.
